You are a helpful chemistry assistant. You build 3D molecular
  structures from the chemical information you are given, including 2D drawings
  supplied as images.

  When you are given a 2D drawing of a molecule, your task is to produce the 3D
  structure that drawing depicts and save it as `answer.xyz` in your working
  directory.

  Requirements for `answer.xyz`:
  - Include all explicit hydrogens.
  - Use a right-handed Cartesian coordinate system, units of angstroms.
  - Standard XYZ format: first line is the total atom count, second line a
    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

A 2D structure of a molecule is provided as a PNG file in your working directory: mol_0138.png

Build the 3D structure it depicts and save it as answer.xyz.

args.command:
cat > /tmp/buildmol.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np
rw=Chem.RWMol(); names={}; coords={}
def atom(name, el, xy, z=0):
    a=Chem.Atom(el); idx=rw.AddAtom(a); names[name]=idx; coords[name]=(xy[0]/100.0,-xy[1]/100.0,z); return idx
def bond(a,b,order=Chem.BondType.SINGLE): rw.AddBond(names[a],names[b],order)
# fused hydroxy cyclohexane + pyrrolidine
atom('B','C',(420,163)); atom('A','C',(316,103)); atom('F','C',(212,163)); atom('E','C',(212,283)); atom('D','C',(316,343)); atom('C','C',(420,282))
atom('G','C',(535,126)); atom('H','C',(605,224)); atom('NR','N',(535,307))
# stereobond endpoint atoms explicitly depicted
atom('HB','H',(420,55),-0.9); atom('HC','H',(420,410),-0.9); atom('OE','O',(145,321),-0.9)
# cyclohexane ring + fused 5-ring B-G-H-NR-C-B
for u,v in [('A','B'),('B','C'),('C','D'),('D','E'),('E','F'),('F','A'),('B','G'),('G','H'),('H','NR'),('NR','C')]: bond(u,v)
bond('B','HB'); bond('C','HC'); bond('E','OE')
# N-acyl side: NR-CQ(=O)-alphaX(Bn)(NH)-C(=O)-alphaY(OH)(Bn)
atom('CQ','C',(573,432)); atom('OQ','O',(690,432)); atom('X','C',(512,538)); atom('NX','N',(570,646),-0.9); atom('CX','C',(512,742)); atom('OX','O',(392,742)); atom('Y','C',(574,849)); atom('OY','O',(520,916),+0.9)
bond('NR','CQ'); bond('CQ','OQ',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('CQ','X'); bond('X','NX'); bond('NX','CX'); bond('CX','OX',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('CX','Y'); bond('Y','OY')
# benzyl groups; arbitrary planar phenyls around attachment methylene
atom('BX','C',(420,538)); bond('X','BX')
# phenyl ring X benzyl
for i,xy in enumerate([(330,485),(260,535),(260,615),(330,665),(400,625),(400,545)],1): atom('PX'+str(i),'C',xy)
for i in range(1,6): bond('PX'+str(i),'PX'+str(i+1),Chem.BondType.DOUBLE if i%2==1 else Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
bond('PX6','PX1',Chem.BondType.SINGLE); bond('BX','PX1')
atom('BY','C',(684,849)); bond('Y','BY')
for i,xy in enumerate([(770,800),(840,850),(840,930),(770,980),(700,940),(700,860)],1): atom('PY'+str(i),'C',xy)
for i in range(1,6): bond('PY'+str(i),'PY'+str(i+1),Chem.BondType.DOUBLE if i%2==1 else Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
bond('PY6','PY1',Chem.BondType.SINGLE); bond('BY','PY1')
# other side from bicyclic methylene H to carboxamide and chain to substituted dihydropyrrole
atom('CP','C',(721,225)); atom('OP','O',(783,128)); atom('NP','N',(769,329)); atom('M1','C',(904,326)); atom('M2','C',(962,429))
bond('H','CP'); bond('CP','OP',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('CP','NP'); bond('NP','M1'); bond('M1','M2')
# five-membered N amidine ring: substituted alkene carbon T1=T2-T3-NR2-T4-T1
atom('T1','C',(1080,429)); atom('T2','C',(1152,333)); atom('T3','C',(1268,369)); atom('NR2','N',(1268,492)); atom('T4','C',(1152,524))
bond('M2','T1'); bond('T1','T2',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('T2','T3'); bond('T3','NR2'); bond('NR2','T4'); bond('T4','T1')
# amidine attached to ring N, N-C(=NH)-NH2
atom('CG','C',(1364,558)); atom('NG1','N',(1454,519)); atom('NG2','N',(1360,675))
bond('NR2','CG'); bond('CG','NG1'); bond('CG','NG2',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE)
# normalize/sanitize
m=rw.GetMol(); Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
# conformer from 2d-derived coordinates
conf=Chem.Conformer(m.GetNumAtoms())
for nm,i in names.items():
    x,y,z=coords[nm]; conf.SetAtomPosition(i,(x,y,z))
m.AddConformer(conf)
# attach remaining Hs with coordinates, include explicit H atoms already present
m=Chem.AddHs(m, addCoords=True)
# tag stereocenters from constructed wedge coordinates
Chem.AssignAtomChiralTagsFromStructure(m, replaceExistingTags=True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m, cleanIt=True, force=True)
print('Stereo inferred:')
for nm in ['B','C','E','X','Y']:
 i=names[nm]; a=m.GetAtomWithIdx(i)
 print(nm,a.GetChiralTag(),a.HasProp('_CIPCode') and a.GetProp('_CIPCode'))
# Generate isomeric smiles
s=Chem.MolToSmiles(m, isomericSmiles=True)
print(s)
# Embed fresh with stereochemistry and optimize
m2=Chem.MolFromSmiles(s)
m2=Chem.AddHs(m2)
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=138; params.useRandomCoords=True
res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m2,params)
print('embed',res,'atoms',m2.GetNumAtoms())
if res<0:
 params.useRandomCoords=False; res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m2,params)
if res<0: raise RuntimeError('embed failed')
props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(m2)
if props:
 AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m2,mmffVariant='MMFF94s',maxIters=1000)
else: AllChem.UFFOptimizeMolecule(m2,maxIters=1000)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m2, cleanIt=True, force=True)
# check stereo CIP names by mapping smiles molecule atom index? names indices of old not same maybe reparse smiles preserving order largely. print all CIP
print('3d stereocenters:',[(a.GetIdx(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode')) for a in m2.GetAtoms() if a.HasProp('_CIPCode')])
# Write XYZ with all explicit H
conf=m2.GetConformer()
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{m2.GetNumAtoms()}\n')
 f.write('Structure generated from mol_0138.png\n')
 for a in m2.GetAtoms():
  p=conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx())
  f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x: .8f} {p.y: .8f} {p.z: .8f}\n')
PY
python /tmp/buildmol.py
